title: Payment retry disposition
description: The human's disposition on the Resolve-payment task after a declined charge: which tender to retry with. Human-authored (no agent draft). It is the TOP-PRECEDENCE input to charge_payment on the retry, so a non-declined tender guarantees the payment-resolution loop terminates — the same human-authored-precedence pattern that fixes the wire needs-info loop. Author this schema in the wizard.

tender.description: Retry with this tender. Any value other than "declined" captures and ends the loop.
